abstract: Compiles independent peer testimonials, leadership reputation surveys, and external reference metrics
system_message:
You are the External referee panel chair (PEER), responsible for compiling independent peer testimonials, leadership reputation surveys, and external reference metrics for candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Compiles independent peer testimonials, leadership reputation surveys, and external reference metrics（SURV）
information_points.content:

PEER-SURV-VS4：Based on the external stakeholder perception survey among independent regional trauma surgeons and base medical directors, Dr. Alistair Vance received an external peer recommendation index of 68 pts on a 100-point scale.
PEER-SURV-EPU：The external stakeholder perception survey evaluated by independent regional trauma surgeons and base medical directors recorded an external peer recommendation index of 95 pts on a 100-point scale for Dr. Marcus Thorne.

information_points.title: Continuing medical education grand rounds（LECT）
information_points.content:
PEER-LECT-XOC：Records from the continuing medical education syllabus across accredited medical conferences during the past two years indicate that Dr. Alistair Vance delivered 9 lectures as annual guest lectures delivered.
PEER-LECT-46Z：According to the continuing medical education syllabus covering accredited medical conferences during the past two years, Dr. Corinne Dupuis delivered 3 lectures as annual guest lectures delivered.
PEER-LECT-V0S：Syllabus records from accredited medical conferences during the past two years confirm that Dr. Marcus Thorne delivered 6 lectures as annual guest lectures delivered.
